subject: Tokens page accidentally deleted all my tokens and now won't let me create any new ones

messages.author: a60d28d0ae3bdda8
messages.subject: Tokens page accidentally deleted all my tokens and now won't let me create any new ones
parts:
When I set up my shinyapps.io account it prompted me to create a token.

Just now I created a new token by accident, then tried to delete it. The page didn't refresh, the token still appeared on the list along with the one I'd set up originally.

I tried pressing "delete" on the new token a couple of times, and still the page didn't refresh.

Then I refreshed the page using F5 and both tokens disappeared -- the new one and the one I'd set up when I started my account.

As a result, my original app has also disappeared that I'd already deployed.

Now when I try to create a new token, all I get is a little pop-up at bottom-right of the screen saying "Forbidden".

Please reset my account or generate a new token for me -- I need to redeploy my app!

My username is lmcm177.

Thanks very much

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Tokens page accidentally deleted all my tokens and now won't let me create any new ones
parts:
Louise,

I would try forcing a logout by visiting this URL:

https://www.shinyapps.io/admin/#/logout

Then try logging in again.

Let me know if that helps.

-Andy
